moments.author: Angel Reese
moments.quote: Waved goodbye to the Mystics—taunt turned viral, with Bonner pulling us back. Sparked a massive fan reaction.
moments.why: A cheeky postgame gesture that exploded across sports and social media, fueling debate around sportsmanship and personality.

moments.author: Allisha Gray
moments.quote: Joined Reese waving goodbye—mocking the Mystics in a postgame wave that went viral.
moments.why: Her participation in the viral moment amplified the clip’s reach and sparked widespread reaction.

moments.author: DeWanna Bonner
moments.quote: Stepped in to pull down the waved hands—veteran leadership in the viral moment.
moments.why: Her quick, corrective action turned her into a social media hero amid the backlash.

moments.author: Sophie Cunningham
moments.quote: Not trying to be dramatic… just here having my morning coffee, and what a damn comeback year for the point!
moments.why: Her TikTok response to a viral altercation injected humor and swagger, trending across WNBA and men’s conversation circles.
